# p64_intro: the intro animations (p101, spec 15.1): the registry, the shared drawing
# helpers, the two embedded logo layers (logo_assets, generated by tools/gen_logo_assets.py)
# and one ia_<name>.cpp per animation. No ESP-IDF includes anywhere (host-tested); the
